content: Fortune favors the bold and resolute heart.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Audentes fortuna iuvat — Virgil (Aeneid X.284) & Classical Gnoma
explanation: Hesitation and endless risk-calculation attract defeat: when you shrink back in terror, circumstances conspire against you. But when you step forward into the fray with decisive resolve, unshakeable courage creates its own unforeseen luck and allies.
practicalInsight: Stop second-guessing yourself. Take the bold, decisive step you have been dreading today and watch the road appear.
reflectionPrompt: Where has timid over-caution been paralyzing you from seizing a magnificent opportunity?
